# Auto Edit

Auto Edit is a browser-based video editor for narration-led creator videos.

## Product
- Editor: /editor
- Features: /features
- How it works: /how-it-works
- About: /about
- Blog: /blog

## Core capabilities
- Script-driven scene timing using JSON or SRT data
- Images and video clips
- Ken Burns motion for still images
- Transition packs and scene-level transition controls
- Captions: fade, slide, typewriter and karaoke
- Background music, auto-ducking, loudness normalization and voice fades
- Color grading presets and manual controls
- Aspect ratios: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5
- MP4 export at 720p, 1080p and 4K

## Documentation
The blog contains practical guides about online editing, captions, transitions, audio, YouTube, Shorts, TikTok and export dimensions.
